title: The real quotient of the Cartwright-Steger surface
summary: Borisov and Yeung showed that the Cartwright-Steger surface $X$ is defined over ${\mathbb {Q}}$, hence complex conjugation gives an antiholomorphic involution on $X$. We show that the orbit space $Y$ is a closed oriented smooth four-manifold homeomorphic to ${\mathbb {CP}}^2\# (S^1 \times S^3)$, presenting $X$ as a double branched cover $X\to Y$, with branch locus diffeomorphic to the connected sum of three copies of the real projective plane.
